svg.title: Afternoon Adventure Learning Center logo - editable vector
svg.desc: Cleaned cartoon illustration of five smiling children. This version keeps the final v9 artwork visually unchanged while organizing every visible vector shape into named, editable groups with unique path IDs, child/body-part classes, and color labels.
